reference.title: Overview
reference.shortdesc: The ADI OtoSense™ SMS has three on-board sensors that collect the data used to monitor

section.p: The ADI OtoSense™ SMS has three on-board sensors that collect the data used to monitor any significant deviation from the established baseline model:

ul.li: Vibration sensors – sense vibration in the X- and Z- axes.
Magnetic field sensor - measures the magnetic field around a motor.
Temperature sensors – measure temperatures of the motor and the environment.

section.p: The REST API fetch data to display status updates on the web and mobile application. For more information, see Appendix B: Cloud Platform Parameters.
